kpis.name: Monthly Procurement BSC section
kpis.comment:
A total of 193 parts were ordered, with a combined value of $11,293.13.
16 purchase orders were raised to support Engineering Addition requirements.
Most orders are currently On Track, with only one order identified as Delayed.
The majority of additions were raised due to Errors/Omissions and Engineering Changes.
As August 2026 was the first month of formal tracking, no historical data is available for trend comparison. This month will serve as the baseline for future performance analysis.
Work is currently in progress to incorporate an additional Requested Delivery Date field within Ostendo, which will improve delivery tracking and reporting accuracy.

Overall: Engineering additions were managed effectively, with 193 parts ordered at a total cost of $11,293.13 and the majority of orders progressing as planned.

q1: Maintained a high order completion rate, with the majority of orders currently On Track and only one order identified as Delayed. Coordinated the procurement of engineering additions, raised and managed purchase orders, monitored supplier progress, and supported the enhancement of tracking capabilities within Ostendo to improve future delivery performance reporting.
q2: One decision I'm particularly proud of this month was introducing a process to review every job after store allocations are completed. By carrying out these checks, I was able to identify BOM omissions and additional material requirements early, ensuring procurement actions were taken promptly to minimise production delays. This proactive approach improved visibility of engineering additions, supported timely ordering of parts, and strengthened overall job readiness.
q3: Implement a proactive job review process following store allocation to identify material gaps early, expedite procurement requirements, and engage suppliers in advance of production demand. This initiative will improve delivery performance, reduce urgent procurement activity, and enhance overall job readiness and schedule adherence.
